body: Use case: stylized-concept. Production eight-direction BODY-ONLY car sprite sheet for Last on Grid. Original logo-free 2994 salvage compact glass-canopy coupe named Glasswing, loosely inspired by a 1990 small Japanese butterfly-door coupe's packaging, not replica. Low rounded wedge bonnet, expansive dark wraparound glass canopy, sweeping hatch, distinctive teal green body with cream patch panels, thin rectangular headlights and trapezoidal low grille, separate small square rear lamps. Hand painted detailed grounded semi-realistic weathered game sprites. Doors CLOSED in all views. NO manufacturer logos, text, badges, people, scenery, tires, wheels or wheel-well backing. Genuine alpha background AND fully transparent empty wheel-arch openings so game's tires behind shell can show. 3:1 wide sheet, EXACTLY 8 equal cells,4 columns2 rows. Row1 left-right: front,front-right,right side,rear-right. Row2:left-right rear,rear-left,left side,front-left. Consistent scale/diffuse lighting, isolated centered whole body in each cell with margins; accurate matching panels across views. No shadows outside shell, no grid, no labels. Maintain visible near and far wheel cutouts. Output transparent PNG.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent cockpit foreground for Last on Grid, original fictional 2994 Glasswing compact glass-canopy coupe interior. Wide2.5:1 driver eye-level dashboard, right-hand drive. Weathered dark blue-gray dashboard with teal repair panels, shallow rounded early1990s design, twin center vents, modest stereo and round climate controls. Entire windshield/upper55% genuine transparent alpha, no scenery; slim A-pillars at outer edges. Lower dashboard spans fullwidth. Right-side dark instrument binnacle around65-85%width,68-84%height, EMPTY blank black instrument face; no painted numbers or gauges. NO steering wheel, no hands, no logos or text; runtime wheel will overlay right-side binnacle. Detailed handpainted semi-realistic salvage game art with believable scratches, no cartoon outlines. Do not draw baked wheels or gauges. Transparent PNG.
edits: background-extraction: preserve exact eight bodies and poses, remove all haze/shadow outside bodies and inside wheel openings; alpha-zero gutters.
precise-object-edit: retain original styling and 4x2 grid; correct right profile nose left, left profile nose right and front-left quarter nose right; keep alpha gutters and empty wheel arches.
